tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Retrieve a specific customer by their ID. Returns customer details including name, email, phone, and status.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List all customers in the database. Can optionally filter by status (active or disabled).

tools.name: add_customer
tools.description: Add a new customer to the database. Name is required, email and phone are optional.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Update an existing customer's information. Provide the customer ID and the fields to update.

tools.name: disable_customer
tools.description: Disable a customer account by setting their status to 'disabled'.

tools.name: activate_customer
tools.description: Activate a customer account by setting their status to 'active'.
